THE CAMPUS EDIT

Good to know.

Welcome to your campus workspace

Explore programs, class timetables, classrooms, faculty and organised campus activities in one place. Additional timetables can be uploaded by an administrator.

Scheduling with confidence

Potential overlaps in the PDF are listed in Schedule manager. They may represent shared classes. Unknown faculty and alternative rooms are not treated as confirmed clashes. New edits are checked before saving.

Keep a timetable backup

Published schedules and activities are shared across the campus portal. Administrators can export a JSON backup from Schedule manager. Personal timetable preferences are remembered in your browser.
